title: The Legend of Hanuman
description: Hanuman (Damandeep Singh Baggan) faces various difficulties while reaching Lanka, but when he finally makes it what he sees on the ‘land of demons’ is completely unexpected, and so is the war ahead. He has to battle hard with Ravan (Sharad Kelkar) in order to find and rescue Sita (Surbhi Pandey) and reunite her with Ram (Sanket Mhatre). For this, he puts Lanka on fire, finishes his task, and then finally proceeds to reunite with his king and his lord.
